name: SFDR 2.0 — Reform Proposal
source: ESA Consultation Paper on SFDR Reform (January 2026)
notes: Proposed reform replaces Article 6/8/9 with a simpler category system. Not yet law. Update this file when the Regulation is finalised.

sustainable.label: Sustainable
sustainable.description: Products primarily investing in activities aligned to environmental or social objectives

proposedCriteria.note: Criteria under consultation — expected to include minimum taxonomy alignment % and PAI thresholds

transition.label: Transition
transition.description: Products investing in activities on a credible transition pathway

proposedCriteria.note: Requires documented transition plan aligned to Paris Agreement

esg.label: ESG Collection
esg.description: Products integrating ESG factors without a specific sustainability objective

proposedCriteria.note: Baseline ESG integration and disclosure requirements

keyChanges: Mandatory PAI disclosure at product level (not just entity level)
Expected to align more closely with EU Taxonomy alignment percentage requirements
